comment: Source read at commit 2b2ad81. Two faults here. Dicotyledon.cpp:77-83 sets switchOut to switchB when the control is above 0 and to switchA otherwise, which is the reverse of what the README states. In the same block the lamps are crossed with the signals: lightSwitchA is set to 1 in the branch that passes switch B. The switch inputs and the switch output carry whatever is patched into them, so they are given no family.
